tagline: The app that develops itself. Ask nothing — it answers.
why: So software explains and improves itself without the user chasing status.
what: A one-page board: Past/Present/Future, Why/What/How, and live self-answers (health, tokens, credits, models, simplicity). Each loop pass ships one version.
how: Stdlib Python server + single-file UI + append-only logs. Loop: heartbeat → ask → unstuck → ship. One running cycle max; finish always bumps version.
